This page shows the spelling the gate requires. Each citation names a stable
anchor rather than a line.

  table.
- `docs/SCHEMA-CUTOVER.md` §Proof graph owns `SCHEMA-PG-WIRE` and its
  `SC-WIRE-01` through `SC-WIRE-05` edges.
